changelog: Full 155-channel lineup (2,982 seed items) with the user-uploaded tier live, old-school commercial breaks (one 30-60 s vintage spot at most once an hour per channel, toggle on the settings page, default ON), 96 h guide window, and additive catalog refreshes that only ever grow the guide. Audiobooks is not served (MP3-only, no audio-only stream path yet).
description: Turns the Internet Archive into a retro-video library and live channels inside Jellyfin.
name: Retro TV
overview: Retro TV — Saturday-morning cartoons, classic TV, drive-in movies and more, from the Internet Archive.
